overview: Vex Thal is the sacred heart of Akhevan civilization.
history: Constructed before the fall of the Akheva, Vex Thal houses their greatest arcane engines, temporal sanctums, and the throne of Aten Ha Ra.
hooks: A void engine destabilizes, threatening the entire citadel.
Temporal sanctums flicker, revealing ancient Akhevan leaders.
A Xi Thall commander summons resonance guardians.
Aten Ha Ra’s presence stirs within the throne chamber.
